Done. I converted [Anime.md](</mnt/d/Git/Ash_ObsidianVault/Cognitive Core/2. Areas/Movies and Entertainment/Watch entries/Anime.md>) into a cleaner Obsidian-friendly table format.

It now has:

- `To Watch` table at the top
- `Completed` table at the bottom
- Checkbox column
- Rating column for completed anime
- Blank row for quickly adding new entries

For moving completed items to the bottom, Obsidian Markdown itself will not automatically move rows when checked. The clean manual workflow is: check the item, move its row from `To Watch` to `Completed`, then add your rating.
